g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when Google Calendar spam invitations are
added automatically
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-25
Check the automatic addition setting
first
On a computer, open Google Calendar, click
Settings (the gear icon) in the upper right, and
open Settings.
Understand the “known sender” criteria
precisely
If you select “Only if the sender is known,” the
event is not added to your calendar
automatically, but the invitation email itself…
Five actions to avoid
① Do not mark an unfamiliar sender as “known.”
The help guide explains that if you mark a
sender as known or interact with them, future…
How to clear existing spam events
First, open the event and check the sender’s
email address, title, and links in the
description.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
